{{Quote|<nowiki>Shafu = intercepted message from Republic bureaucrat // Bureaucrat = human named Eckhorn // Eckhorn = member of House Baliss on Alderaan // Eckhorn = Imperial spy</nowiki>|T7-O1|<ref name="Eckhorn's List" />}}
'''Eckhorn Baliss''' was an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] and member of [[House Baliss]] who served as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In his capacity as a Republic statesman, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] observed other members of the government and eventually compiled a list of Imperial sympathizers that the Empire could potentially turn into double agents, and he hid this list in [[House Baliss (estate)|his house's estate]].<ref name="Eckhorn's List" /> However, one of these sympathizers&mdash;the [[Verre Sydia's husband|husband]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Verre Sydia]], who unbeknownst to Baliss was also an Imperial operative<ref name="The Truth Comes Out">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|The Truth Comes Out}}</ref>&mdash;hired the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Terrin Sandafar]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Baliss.<ref name="Terrin Sandafar">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|Terrin Sandafar}}</ref>

As was her style,<ref name="Terrin Sandafar" /> Sandafar killed Baliss by rigging [[Eckhorn Baliss' ship|his ship]] to explode<ref name="Shafu's Report">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|Shafu's Report}}</ref> in [[3663 BBY]]<ref name="Time" /> above his [[Planet/Legends|homeworld]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], a seemingly accidental event that was later investigated by the former [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Shafu]] on behalf of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]]. Shafu was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Sandafar as well,<ref name="Shafu's Report" /> but his death and Baliss' were investigated by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]].<ref name="Terrin Sandafar" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eckhorn Baliss was first mentioned in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he is the subject of several conversations with the Jedi Knight companion character T7-O1.<ref name="Eckhorn's List" />
